title: February 2026 White Sands event and El Paso airspace closure
place_text: White Sands, New Mexico; El Paso, Texas

tellings.quote: what happened at White Sands in February of 2026?

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, asks a guest what happened at White Sands, a military area in New Mexico, in February 2026, an event tied in the story to a closure of the airspace over El Paso, Texas. No details are given beyond the question. The point of asking is the suggestion that something unusual happened there that officials have not explained.
